description: Normative inventory of exclusive runtime resources. Every entry must declare owner, borrow scope, completion point, capacity/limit, and stop/error behaviour, with at least one fault/stress evidence test.

resources.borrow: GpuResourceHandle is generational; resolve/state fails on stale generation
resources.completion: SubmissionContext complete/cancel/destructor drains holds; retiring payload destroyed once when holds hit zero
resources.limit: Fixed registry capacity; create fails when full
resources.stop_or_error: Failed slots are terminal; partial init (null/throwing payload) publishes no handle

resources.owner: SubmissionContext retains handles for one GPU submission
resources.borrow: retain() pins uploading/resident handles only for this context lifetime
resources.completion: complete() or cancel(); destructor cancels if unfinished
resources.limit: Bounded by registry capacity and retained handle list

resources.borrow: pixels() only while writable; frozen_bytes() under GPU/sink holds until recycle
resources.completion: complete_gpu/complete_sink and release recycle when idle
resources.limit: Fixed E-style capacity; try_acquire returns would_block without fallback growth
resources.stop_or_error: cancel() never clears busy bytes; delayed completion after cancel preserves frozen data

resources.borrow: No borrowed view; credit is an exclusive move-only lease
resources.completion: Destructor or release() returns credit to the pool
resources.stop_or_error: close() wakes blocked acquire; held credits remain owned by holders

resources.owner: BoundedQueue storage until successful pop or abort retirement
resources.borrow: No views across the queue; values are moved in/out
resources.completion: pop transfers ownership to consumer; abort retires pending items outside the mutex
resources.limit: Fixed capacity; try_push leaves caller value untouched on WouldBlock
resources.stop_or_error: close drains; abort cancels waiters and retires pending ownership

resources.owner: RenderJob owns CompiledScene and phase/error budget
resources.borrow: scene() returns borrowed view valid while the job lives
resources.completion: Terminal published*/failed/cancelled phases; export advances phases
resources.limit: Resource budget tracked on the job; workers/GPU stay outside the type
resources.stop_or_error: Cancel wins only before publishing; late callbacks use shared contexts that outlive stack frames

resources.owner: OutputTransaction owns staging directory beside the target
resources.borrow: staging_file path is valid until publish or abort cleanup
resources.completion: commit() publishes via rename; destructor cleans only unpublished staging
resources.limit: Single staging job nonce; no_replace refuses existing targets
resources.stop_or_error: Stop before publish gate aborts without renaming; never deletes a published target

resources.owner: CfOwner retained CF wrapper (ARC/autorelease pool at call sites)
resources.borrow: get() is a borrowed CFTypeRef valid while the owner retains it
resources.completion: reset/destructor CFRelease; explicit second retain survives retirement of the first owner
resources.stop_or_error: Moved-from owner is empty; autorelease pool drains Objective-C temporaries at scope end

resources.owner: AppleVideoSink State owning AVAssetWriter path and pixel-buffer pool
resources.borrow: Domain callers never see AVFoundation types; EncodableFrame is consumed on append
resources.completion: finish() or cancel(); destructor joins deferred cancel completion
resources.stop_or_error: cancel() is noexcept; late cancel completion must not outlive joined destructor
